title: How the Masquers began
summary: The Soulshapers before and after the Guild.

claims.text: Wraiths learned that a Corpus could be reshaped long before Inhabit was taught, so Masquers scoff at the Artificers' claim to be the eldest Guild.

Small trade circles of Soulshapers had long worked like family crafts; tradition says one of the earliest Anonymae drew the best of them together, after which an envoy pledged the Masquers' Guild to Charon's court.
Other Guilds name the Masquers among the two great traitors of Guild history.
The young Guild showed deep respect for rank but served anyone who could pay, and soon offered far more than cosmetic or military reshaping: information gathering and murder among them.
In many Necropoli this grew into something like organized crime, often with Hierarchy officials taking a share.

title: Masquers and the Mnemoi
summary: An old rivalry in the trade of secrets.

claims.text: Masquer apprentices learn that the Mnemoi were their rivals in brokering information, competing for oboli and Pathos; the memory-miners took to unmasking Moliated spies and assassins, and the rivalry became a secret war.
Masquer historians boast that their Guildmasters quietly turned Charon against the Mnemoi; comparing a Masquer to a Mnemos is still a grave insult.
